ejecutora.subtext: In collaboration with universities, public research institutes, and strategic partners across Peru, Ecuador, and the United States, we foster ongoing innovation and regional technology transfer.

informatica-biomedica.desc: Biomedical Informatics integrates principles of computer science, information science, and health sciences to manage, analyze, and optimize clinical information. Within the BI4DT Network, this area encompasses hospital information system design and implementation, the adoption of international standards such as HL7 FHIR and DICOM, and the development of electronic health records tailored to the Latin American context.

ia-salud.desc: The Artificial Intelligence in Health track at the BI4DT Network explores advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques to transform clinical practice. Our projects include computer-aided diagnosis systems, automated medical imaging analysis (X-rays, CT scans), clinical natural language processing in Spanish, and predictive models for epidemiological surveillance.

interoperabilidad.desc: Healthcare interoperability is the ability of information systems to communicate, exchange data, and effectively use shared information. This line at the BI4DT Network focuses on implementing clinical data governance frameworks, adopting international standards, and designing digital health policies at institutional and national levels.

analitica-datos.desc: This research area addresses predictive modeling, advanced biostatistics, and the analysis of large volumes of healthcare data. It develops clinical-molecular integration algorithms, mathematical models for infectious disease prediction, and maternal-child health indicators on a regional scale.

sociotecnica-adopcion.desc: Sociotechnical Evaluation and Adoption examines the interaction between healthcare professionals, health institutions, and emerging technological solutions. It focuses on digital health public policy formulation, regulatory frameworks, and techno-financial monitoring of R&D initiatives.

salud-digital.desc: The Digital Health track develops and implements telemedicine and mobile health (mHealth) solutions designed to expand access to medical care in vulnerable populations and rural areas with low connectivity, while integrating binational platforms for digital epidemiological surveillance.

quienes.mision_desc: Consolidate an inter-institutional and intersectoral network in biomedical informatics that articulates governance, applied research, STI capacity building, scientific dissemination, and sustainability, closing digital capacity gaps in the healthcare system.
quienes.vision_desc: To be a benchmark network in biomedical informatics and digital health in Peru and the region, recognized for its collaboration among academia, government, healthcare providers, and international partners, and for its continuity beyond the grant period.
quienes.mapa_desc: We collaborate with universities, research centers, and healthcare providers in Peru, Ecuador, the United States, and Japan to enhance biomedical innovation.
